Title: Architecture review gate C
Purpose: Stop after lifecycle and side-effect hardening, then decide whether the remaining work is only structural follow-up rather than unresolved correctness.
Deliverables: A written Gate C memo with explicit pass/fail decision.
A statement of whether all red correctness/invariant gaps are now closed.
A corrective subbundle if lifecycle or side-effect hardening is still incomplete.
ValidationCommands: Review the live repository and proof after subbundles 07-08 before continuing.
ReviewQuestions: Are single-draft, single-published, active-version safety, and version allocation now hard invariants rather than service assumptions?
Are search/activity side effects now durable enough that command semantics are no longer post-commit fragile?
Can the remaining work honestly be treated as structural follow-up instead of unresolved correctness?
CorrectiveOnFailure: If any answer is no, stop and execute the lifecycle or side-effect corrective playbook before continuing.
